To get your savings balance (and make it show up here in the future), you’ll need to contact the bank directly so they can locate and link the account. The fastest options are usually:
- Call the number on the back of your debit/ATM card or on your bank’s website, or  
- Visit a branch with your ID and any document that shows the savings account number.

- Your savings account isn’t appearing in your online profile or digital assistant,
- You need the current balance, and
- You want them to confirm and link that savings account to your main customer profile.
